report:
Trouvailles :

Il n’y a pas d’épanchement intra-articulaire significatif ou de kyste poplité.

Il y a changements dégénératifs légers à modérés au niveau patellofémoral. Il y a amincissement du cartilage avec fibrillation superficielle plus proéminent impliquant la facette latérale de la rotule avec fissure partielle de la facette médiale. Il y a aussi un léger amincissement du cartilage à la partie latérale de la trochlée du fémur. La rotule démontre une légère subluxation latérale. Il y a aussi œdème au niveau de la partie supéro-latérale du pad graisseux infra-rotulien entre le tendon rotulien et le condyle fémoral externe.

Le cartilage du compartiment interne et externe est préservé. Les ménisques sont sans particularité. Autrement le ligament croisé antérieur, le ligament croisé postérieur, le mécanisme des extenseurs, le ligament collatéral interne, le semi-membraneux, le muscle et tendon du poplité, le biceps fémoris distal, le ligament collatéral externe et la bandelette ilio-tibiale sont sans particularité.

Conclusion :

Œdème au niveau du pad graisseux suggestif d’un syndrome de friction (patellar tendon lateral femoral condyle friction syndrome). Il y a aussi changements dégénératifs au niveau patellofémoral. La combinaison des trouvailles est suggestif d’une biomécanique anormale au niveau patellofémoral.

Mediales Kompartiment:
Intakter Knorpel. Intakter Innenmeniskus In Korrelation zu dem Summationsbild vom [DATE] abgrenzbare max. 9 mm messende Verkalkung in der meniskotibialen Aufhängung des Innenmeniskus mit minimal angrenzendem Knochenödem im medialen Tibiaplateau. Ansonsten regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Proximale Partialläsion des MCL (Grad 2).

Laterales Kompartiment:
[DATE]. 1 cm messende subchondrale Zyste in der lateralen Femurcondyle mit fokal tief greifendem Knorpeldefekt (Serie 6/ Image 25). Ansonsten regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal und intakter Knorpel. Kein vollschichtiger Knorpeldefekt. 

Femoropatellares Gleitlager und Trochlea:
Zur Voruntersuchung vom konstant oberflächliche Knorpelirrgeularität an der inferiomedialen Patellafacette (Serie 7/ Image 13). Kein tiefgreifender oder vollschichtiger Knorpeldefekt. Sulcus-Winkel von 148° im Sinne einer Trochleadysplasie Typ A nach Dejour. Patellaform  Typ III nach Wiberg.

Kreuzbänder:
Intakte Kreuzbänder.

Muskulatur und übrige Weichteile:
Geringer Gelenkerguss mit verdickter Synovia. Bekanntes zur konventionellen Röntgenaufnahme vom [DATE] und [DATE] jeweils  lagedifferentes 5 x 11 x cc 12 mm messendes freies osteochondrales Fragment angrenzend an die laterale Femurcondyle (Serie 4/ Image 15).

MRI of right Knee with 
-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS

* Obliteration of lateral meniscus, reflecting tear. 
* Osteophytes and irregular thining of intra-articular cartilage, more severe at lateral femorotibial joint with subchondral sclerosis and mild edema and tiny cystic change, reflecting osteoarthritis
  Grade 3 chondromalacia of patella and femoral trochlea
* Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar, lateral and medial plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
> A lobulated cystic lesion in medial popliteal fossa between the tendons of the medial head of the gastrocnemius and the semimembranosus muscles, in favor of Baker's cyst.
  Mild fat stranding over popliteal fossa.
> The contour of ACL & PCL appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> Mild subcutaneous edema over right knee.

Impression: 
1.Osteoarthritis of right knee, more severe at lateral femorotibial joint.
2.Tear of lateral meniscus.
3.Moderate joint effusion-synovitis of right knee and large Baker's cyst.
4.Mild subcutanoeus edema over right knee.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Chronic right knee pain worse with activity. Intermittently gives out, localized anteriorly.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: High-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss about the anterior weightbearing aspect lateral femoral condyle more centrally towards the intercondylar notch. Low-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss along the central and posterior lateral tibial plateau.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: High-grade partial-thickness fissuring at the median ridge.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 14 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
Lateral tibiofemoral and patellofemoral compartment chondrosis as described.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Left knee pain; anterior pain with popping and clicking; no history of injury
Comparison: Radiograph of the left knee dated [DATE]

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.0 system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. 3 small Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Mild intrasubstance heterogeneous signal intensity at the junction of the body and posterior horn. No definite meniscal tear.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: There is is mild cartilage irregularity and fissuring at the medial patellar facet.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No mild lateral patellar tilt. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Top normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 15 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. Mild patellofemoral osteoarthritis. Mild lateral patellar tilt, which may be seen in the setting of patellar tracking abnormality.

2. Intact menisci and ligaments.

3. Very small popliteal cyst.

A. Ligaments 
 ACL: Complete tear; anterior tibial translation about 8 mm is noted. 
 PCL:Intact. 
 MCL: Intact.  
 LCL complex and Iliotibial band: intact. 
  
 B. Menisci 
 Medial meniscus: Bucket handle tear 
 Lateral meniscus: A small T2 hyperintense focus abutting the inferior surface of the posterior horn. 
  
 C. Extensor Mechanism 
 Distal quadriceps tendon: Normal.  
 Patellar tendon: Normal.  
 Patella: Normally located in the femoral groove. 
  
 D. Fluid  and  Soft Tissue 
 Joint effusion and fluid in suprapatellar bursa are seen. 
 Few osteochondral bodies at the posteromedial aspect of the left knee joint, posterior to the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, is present 
 No soft tissue mass. 
 No Baker's cyst is seen. 
  
 E. Osseous Structures  and  Articular Cartilages 
 Faint bone contusion at the posterior aspect of the proximal tibia is shown. 
 No gross fracture or osseous destruction. 
 Thinning and increased signal intensity of articular cartilages at the patellofemoral and medial tibiofemoral compartments are shown. 
 Osteophytes are present 
 Cannot exclude small perforation at the inferior (articular) surface of the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus Complete ACL tear with associated mild bone contusion 
 Bucket handle tear of the medial meniscus 
 Mild bone contusion 
 Degenerative changes of the left knee joint with chondromalacia (Grade II) at the meidlal tibiofemoral and patellofemoral compartments. Also, note the presence of osteochondral bodies, which may represent secondary synovial chondromatosis.

Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales sin alteraciones.
Meniscos de morfología y señal conservada, sin criterios categóricos de rotura.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones. Signos de
displasia troclear.
Cartílago rotuliano sin lesiones significativas.
Discreto edema de la grasa prefemoral y del aspecto superoexterno de la grasa de Hoffa.
Tendones cuadricipital, la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites
normales. Mínimo aumento de señal del aspecto proximal del tendón rotuliano.
No hay derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos patológicos.
Impresión:
Signos de displasia troclear.
Edema de la grasa prefemoral y del aspecto superoexterno de la grasa de Hoffa que podría
representar fenómenos de mal alineamiento rotuliano.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal

Keine frische Fraktur. Kollateralbänder und Kreuzbänder intakt. Mukoide Degeneration im Innenmeniskus am Hinterhorn, keine Rissbildung. Oberflächliche randständige Chondropathie am medialen Femurkondylus randständig. Subchondral am medialen Femurkondylus geringe Signalveränderungen (5/22), mglw. im Rahmen einer SIF. Geringer Kniegelenkserguss mit Reizssynovialitis. Ödmsignal im anterioren suprapatellaren Fettkörper.
